name: Gohmann Supply, LLC
old_description: GOHMANN SUPPLY, LLC is a family owned and operated company founded in 2009 by Chris & Heather Gohmann.
about:
Gohmann Supply, LLC is a family-owned business founded in 2009 by Chris and Heather Gohmann in St. Cloud, Minnesota. Chris Gohmann brought seven years of hands-on experience from a central Minnesota meat market, where he worked from kill-floor cleanup to retail sales and all processing steps. He later joined a nationally known manufacturing firm, serving as a service technician, technical trainer, and regional sales consultant for the Southwest U.S., before returning to his passion for meat processing by starting the company.

The company supplies food processing equipment and related products, offering both new and pre-owned machinery alongside a range of supplies such as trolleys, gambrels, and rail components. Gohmann Supply represents multiple brands and emphasizes responsive service and technical support, drawing on Chris Gohmann’s field service and training background. The operation runs from a facility in St. Cloud, though specific headcount and facility size are not disclosed.

Primary customers are meat and food processors, from small butcher shops to larger processing plants. The company’s mission centers on providing quality equipment and supplies backed by service and support, targeting the meat and food processing sectors.

Gohmann Supply differentiates itself through its family-owned structure, direct industry experience, and a commitment to offering better brands at competitive values with responsive support. The availability of pre-owned equipment at quality prices is also highlighted as a key value proposition.

The branch is managed by Michael Knotts and serves a territory stretching from Indianapolis to Fort Wayne, Evansville, Louisville, Terre Haute, Bloomington, South Bend, Mishawaka, and Elkhart.

The company maintains a fully stocked showroom and warehouse offering popcorn machines, cotton candy equipment, Sno‑Kone® systems, hot dog rollers, fryers, and related concession supplies. The branch differentiates itself through personalized service, local market knowledge, and shipping cost savings for regional customers. The company states that customer service is its top priority, emphasizing hands‑on support and rapid access to inventory.

name: Golden Eagle Woodwork LLC
old_description: Golden Eagle Woodwork began with a vision to provide high quality craftsmanship and satisfaction to its customers. That continues to be the owner's focus today. The owner, Jaime Vazquez, began his career installing interior trim in the high-end custom homes of the ski resort slopes in Vail and Beaver Creek in Colorado. In the early 2000's, Jaime moved to our beloved Montana and continued with the same drive and vision to provide the custom homes in Big Sky with a quality product that exceeds the customer's expectations.
about:
Golden Eagle Woodwork LLC operates from Bozeman, Montana. The company was founded by Jaime Vazquez after he relocated to Montana in the early 2000s, bringing experience from installing interior trim in high-end custom homes on the ski resort slopes of Vail and Beaver Creek, Colorado. Vazquez established the business to serve the custom home market in the Big Sky region with a focus on craftsmanship and customer satisfaction.

The company provides a range of carpentry and woodworking services through its custom wood shop. Offerings include full trim packages, custom cabinet builds, custom built-ins, interior trim carpentry, door and hardware installation, interior casework, and wood wall and ceiling paneling. Golden Eagle also operates as a general contractor, handling remodels and custom builds for both residential and commercial projects.

Golden Eagle serves general contractors and homeowners primarily in the Bozeman and Big Sky areas. Its client base includes custom home builders and remodelers seeking finish carpentry and millwork for high-end residential and commercial properties. The company expanded its outreach to additional contractors in the region starting in 2019.

The founder’s stated vision centers on delivering high-quality craftsmanship that exceeds customer expectations. Golden Eagle emphasizes attention to detail across all aspects of a project, from base and casework to tongue-and-groove wood ceilings, aiming for supreme satisfaction from both contractors and clients.

name: Golden Solar
old_description: We design, develop and install complete solar panel PV systems for residential and commercial installations throughout Colorado.
about:
Golden Solar is a locally owned solar installation company based in Golden, Colorado, founded in 2006. The company began as a designer, developer, and installer of complete solar panel photovoltaic (PV) systems for residential and commercial customers throughout Colorado.

The company provides end-to-end solar solutions including system design, installation, and ongoing service and repair. Its offerings span residential and commercial PV installations, home micro-grid systems, smart electrical panels for home automation, electric vehicle charger installation, and battery storage integration using Tesla Powerwall units. Golden Solar operates across the Denver metro area and the wider state, handling projects from single-family homes to larger commercial buildings.

Golden Solar serves homeowners, business owners, and non-profit organizations in Colorado. Its residential clients seek to reduce energy costs and carbon footprint, while commercial customers include businesses of various sizes looking to offset utility expenses and gain energy independence. The company also works with non-profits to implement solar solutions aligned with sustainability goals.

The company’s stated purpose is to empower people and communities to take control of their energy future through decentralization and micro-grid technology. Golden Solar emphasizes core values such as doing the job right the first time, treating business as a relationship rather than a transaction, personal accountability, and a team-oriented culture. Its niche focus on home micro-grids reflects a vision of energy resilience and local economic development.

Gondwana & Divine Clothing Co. operates a women's apparel boutique in Concord, New Hampshire. The customer base consists of individual shoppers looking for women's fashion in a variety of sizes. Testimonials on the site note that the assortment accommodates different body shapes and style preferences. The store offers free standard shipping on orders exceeding $150.

Shoppers repeatedly cite the knowledge and friendliness of the sales staff as a primary reason for loyalty. Reviews describe the team as helpful and dedicated to ensuring customers feel confident in their purchases. The company highlights these testimonials on its homepage.

name: Good Wood Nashville
old_description: Since 2012, we’ve built a reputation for offering unique materials that bring warmth and authenticity to every space.
about:
Good Wood Nashville was founded in 2012 in Nashville, Tennessee, as a locally owned lumber store. The company began with a focus on supplying unique, character-rich wood materials to the Middle Tennessee region.

Operating from a 15,000-square-foot warehouse located 1.5 miles from downtown Nashville, the company stocks a curated selection of premium dimensional lumber, hardwood flooring, live-edge slabs, mantels, beam wraps, reclaimed barnwood, and plywood. It also distributes Festool brand tools and offers turn-key installation on select projects. Materials are shipped nationwide across the United States.

The supplier serves a mix of homeowners, custom home builders, interior designers, contractors, architects, and woodworkers. Its materials have been used in new construction, historic renovations, and commercial fit-outs throughout Nashville and beyond.

Good Wood Nashville emphasizes American-sourced, tariff-free lumber, highlighting a curated inventory chosen for quality, character, and timeless appeal. The company also carries Lunawood, a thermally modified Nordic pine and spruce product line from Finland, marketed for its durability and sustainability.

name: Goose Woodworking, LLC
old_description: *Please note – Goose Woodworking, LLC specializes in making custom, handmade furniture out of high-quality hardwoods and products. As a general rule, we do not build anything out of pine or construction grade lumber from big box stores.
about:
Goose Woodworking, LLC operates from Leesburg, Virginia, as a small business founded by Wayne, who serves as both owner and lead craftsman. The company’s name comes from an old Army nickname, reflecting the founder’s military background, and the shop runs with the “Army of One” ethos—Wayne personally oversees every build while a backend team handles operations.

The shop produces custom, handmade furniture and home decor exclusively from premium hardwoods such as walnut, sapele, mahogany, cherry, maple, and white oak, milled in-house. Finishes range from Rubio Monocoat hard wax oil and Tung oil to custom blends, Arm-R-Seal, conversion varnish, milk paint, and wood stains from General Finishes. Each project follows a structured process: client inspiration leads to a CAD design drawing, a 50 % deposit secures a first-in-first-out build slot, and lead times typically run 8–10 weeks.

Customers are primarily residential clients looking to replicate or adapt pieces seen in catalogs from Wayfair, West Elm, or Restoration Hardware, or on platforms like Pinterest, Instagram, and Etsy. Recent commissions include dining and coffee tables, chairs, benches, and specialty items such as a bourbon cabinet built from a reclaimed barrel with mahogany shelves and LED lighting.

Wayne’s direct involvement ensures that no pine or construction‑grade lumber enters the shop, and the finish process includes up to three stain samples cut from the project’s own off‑cuts so clients can verify color in their own lighting. The company positions itself on quality over quantity, emphasizing materials and craftsmanship that exceed mass‑produced imports.

name: Grain Designs
old_description: Built near Fargo, ND, Grain Designs was founded by architectural designers with a passion for craftsmanship. No imported, mass-produced furniture. We use premium materials, thoughtfully designed and built to fit your space.
about:
Grain Designs operates near Fargo, North Dakota. The company was founded in 2013 by architectural designers who began building furniture in a two-stall garage in Fargo. The founders' names are not disclosed, and the ownership structure is not publicly specified beyond being a privately held studio.

The studio designs and manufactures custom office and residential furniture, including reception desks, office desks, conference tables, live-edge tables, dining tables, and podcast and media desks. Pieces are crafted from solid hardwoods using a combination of design consultation, custom drafting, and in-house woodworking. From its garage origins, the operation has expanded to a design-and-build studio at a location called The Pines, and the company reports having assisted over 100 businesses with office spaces.

Grain Designs serves commercial office clients, residential customers, and media-production environments. Named projects include work for NorthStar Financial (conference tables, sit-stand desks, shelving), Enclave Companies' flagship office (meeting tables, conference table, shelving), and a "You Betcha!" build (office desks, podcast table, container bar). The company also works directly with homeowners on custom residential pieces.

The company emphasizes a "Custom without Compromise" approach, offering custom-designed hardwood desks and tables at prices comparable to or lower than mass-produced commercial office furniture, with a typical build time of as little as six weeks and a commitment to on-time, on-budget delivery. Its "Character Driven" philosophy centers on building relationships rather than mass production, and all furniture is made in North Dakota without imported components.

name: Grand Forks Welding-Machine Co
old_description: Whether you’re looking for a specific part or have an obsolete part, at Grand Forks Welding & Machine we offer custom fabrication, so you don’t have to mess around with going to a manufacturer. We work with you on your specific needs and can fulfill most projects within 2 weeks or less.
about:
Grand Forks Welding & Machine traces its roots to 1885, when an ambitious blacksmith shop opened as the Grand Forks Foundry in what was then Dakota Territory. The operation began by repairing riverboats on the Red River before expanding to serve builders, manufacturers, and agricultural producers across the region. Today the company operates from Grand Forks, North Dakota.

The shop provides custom fabrication, repair, machining, and drive-line services, complemented by a CNC plasma cutting table and a stocked parts department. It carries carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum, and plastics in flats, rounds, and tubing, and supplies branded components such as Riker exhaust parts, Neapco and Weasler PTO components, Waterscheid PTO parts, and Dexter trailer parts. No facility size or headcount figures are published.

Customers come from construction, general manufacturing, agriculture, and the trailer-transportation sector. The parts department is positioned to eliminate downtime for equipment operators who need replacement components quickly.

The company emphasizes a reputation for high-quality work and service, noting that its trained staff can help design, build, or repair almost anything a client envisions. Most projects are quoted at two weeks or less from order to completion.
